scope: Original conceptual schematics of rough-option simulation/inference and physical-path prefix inference; no empirical results or model-accuracy claims.

visual_inspiration.author_credit: Stefan T. Radev, Introduction to Simulation-Based Inference
visual_inspiration.use: Original arrangement and labels, using the Heston lesson palette and training/inference separation. No source artwork copied.

notation.rough: Known curve targets H/eta/rho with seven supplied xi_0 levels; joint targets also S/L/k and excludes its generating curve from conditions.
notation.rough_price_error: Finite-path MC error is numerical pricing error, distinct from prescribed Gaussian observation noise.
notation.trajectory: Theta is the full static parameter vector, including physical drift mu. r_1:T is the complete revealed daily return prefix. Variance and generating labels are excluded from new-case conditions.
notation.prefix_posterior: Each prefix posterior uses the original prior and the whole revealed history; overlapping-prefix posteriors are not multiplied.

publication: Publish PNG and provenance JSON only through lab/studies/accept.py --run; editable SVG and rendering source remain in lab evidence.
